verdict.rationale: The documentation index lists a dedicated "Get Account Payment (ACH) details" capability alongside "Validate account details" and account-ownership verification, all drawn from accounts linked through Connect. That matches the core of obtaining verified ACH details from a linked account. The evidence is only index headings, though, with no endpoint-level detail. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that account and routing numbers are returned, any mention of tokenized account numbers, an explicit statement that this replaces micro-deposits, endpoint-level docs for the ACH details call, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
